stories.notes: Live Preview is a complex, user-facing, cross-locale (GO, UP, MX) CMS feature with zero acceptance criteria and no existing spec. Assigning both agents: openspec first to elaborate requirements, define AC, and propose technical depth for real-time rendering and multi-locale preview; then speckit to harden with testability criteria, security checks, and edge-case coverage (e.g., locale fallback, preview latency, concurrent edits, iframe sandboxing).

agentContributions.notes: Novel capability — live preview does not exist in current codebase. useContent (236 callers) and ContentstackContext are the attachment points. ACs were empty; VCs derived entirely from description. All VCs stop at the Contentstack boundary since that service is unreachable at test time.

Openspec produced an empty AC list, noting this is a novel capability with no existing live-preview code. All 12 ACs are new and derived from the story description, title, and the listed attachment-point files (useContent, ContentstackContext, contentCard, ContentstackLink, contentstack service). CAVEAT: I could not read the source files, so AC-6 (atomic multi-field updates) and AC-12 (ContentstackLink re-rendering) may need adjustment once the actual data-flow and component structure is known. AC-8 and AC-10 address backwards-compatibility and SPA navigation edge cases that were not mentioned in the description but are critical for a non-breaking integration. AC-9 covers malformed payloads — essential because live-preview streams are inherently less stable than published API responses. AC-11 addresses out-of-order delivery, a common issue with real-time event streams.
